body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Filed by the seat from the runner's report (runner session `session_01QSeKYoESgHNUWedESwaNye`); the runner made no GitHub write.

## Environment fingerprint
- Framework sha: f6f5b50a05763850f3f9658cd475cc3059604043 (detached origin/main, fixed for the whole round; the `ui/` console source is this same tree). The tree was clean at close, and examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/ was never created.
- Toolchain: node v22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, vitest 4.1.12. Container: 4 CPUs, 15 GB RAM.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` took 22 s. `pnpm build --concurrency=2` built 119/119 tasks in 12m05s with EXIT 0, and `check:dev-prereqs` was green. The build compiled the showcase artifact `examples/app-showcase/dist/objectstack.json` at 09:38 (sha256 prefix 4f939630e342c8df); every tree boot served it with `--no-compile --no-watch`.
- Boots: `objectstack dev --no-compile --no-watch --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa-*/RUNNER/ITEM/data.db`, with OS_PORT, OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT and OS_HOME set per boot. Ports were 42100–42900, one port and one DB per item. Seeds: `com.example.showcase 141 rows`.
- Other boot types:
  - Private compiled copies for the self-pinging connector items.
  - Scratch copies for external-datasource writes.
  - Walled boots from `qa-fixture walled-boot`, isolated and group.
  - An OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1 boot for the clock-driven items.
- Pins: run with `--maxWorkers=1 --reporter=tree`, one vitest process per runner, and `packages/qa/dogfood` one file per invocation. Four dogfood files were killed with SIGKILL (exit 137) by the memory cap while sibling runners held memory; each passed when re-run alone. No pin failed an assertion.
- Execution: in parallel, through 8 runner subagents at effort high on the dispatching model:
  - 4 Tier 1 pin batches, one area group each;
  - 4 Tier 2/3 groups driven by hand.
- Time: 2026-11-17, 09:31–10:35 UTC.

## Scope
- Selector: `surface:api`. `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:api --json` resolved 158 runnable items. It hid 8 blocked items, which were not run: i18n.seed-dataset-follows-organization-language, integration-system.oracle-federated-read-write, integration-system.oracle-raw16-uuid-reference, integration-system.mssql-federated-read-write, platform-core.multi-replica-package-change-refusal, platform-core.ready-cluster-driver-health, platform-core.settings-change-reaches-every-replica, platform-core.shared-redis-cache-across-replicas. No planned item matched.
- Tiers:
  - Tier 1, items with `automated.ref`: 111, all judged.
  - Tier 2, unpinned P0/P1: 34, all judged.
  - Tier 3, unpinned P2: 13, all judged.
- Each item's revision is on its line below.
- Item-derivation rule used: an item is PASS when every clause passed, FAIL when any clause failed, and PARTIAL otherwise, provided at least one clause was consulted. A clause pinned only above its oracle's layer is scored `partial` under RUNNER rule 6.

## Per-clause verdict table (one item per line; clause details after the verdict)
Layer key: HTTP-ip = in-process HTTP dogfood boot; LIVE = a real `os dev` boot; unit / engine / dispatcher = RUNNER rule 6.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)
- Budget: about 2–5 minutes per item on the same boots and personas. One runner spent no probe time on connector-degraded-recovery: its server was stopped before probing.
- Boundary classes tried: empty, blank, whitespace and unknown ids and keys; malformed JSON; boundary sizes; personas outside the asserted scope (member, auditor, anonymous); forged headers (X-User-Id, X-Forwarded-For); and the opposite posture (isolated beside group).
- No probe finding passed the filing gate as a confirmed product defect. These observations are unverified against their contracts, and the seat triages them:
  - Error-envelope dialect drift:
    - malformed JSON on `POST /data/:object` answers nested `{success:false,error:{…}}` while other refusals on that door are flat;
    - `/batch` Zod refusals carry `issues[]` rather than `fields[]`;
    - the approvals routes answer `{code,error}`;
    - the MFA 403 is `{error:{code,message}}`;
    - the metadata PUT 422 is top-level `{error,code,issues}`.
  - `/batch` with a whitespace-only id `"   "` answers 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND where an empty id answers 400 "requires an id".
  - Record share: `POST …/shares` with a nonexistent `recipientId` answers 201 and stores a dangling share row.
  - Empty `If-Match` on a metadata create answers 409 METADATA_CONFLICT, while a malformed `If-None-Match` answers 400.
  - The agent NOT_OVERRIDABLE message cites ADR-0131 (organization ownership) for code-only sealing.
  - A package's installedAt loses its milliseconds across a restart.
  - A seed draft for a nonexistent object saves 200 and publishes "published" with an error-severity `seed_not_applied` probe issue.
  - Recycle-bin on an unknown object answers 403 rather than 404 to an admin.
  - An aggregate on a list-denied object answers a 405 naming `list`, not `aggregate`.
